description: Captures the deterministic vanilla DOOM 1.9 damage-death-reborn cycle from E1M1 spawn: scripted self-damage path (idclip into a damage sector or scripted projectile hit) reducing player health to <= 0, the S_PLAY_DIE death animation chain (S_PLAY_DIE1 through S_PLAY_DIE7 and S_PLAY_XDIE1 through S_PLAY_XDIE9), USE-key reborn timer, and the player respawning at the deathmatch start with full single-player health.
captureMethod: From 02-020 spawn, force damage via deterministic projectile or scripted route into a -10/tic damage sector, capture state at health-zero tic, death-animation end tic, and the post-USE reborn tic.
